# Test-WindowsPrivileged.ps1

Runs the Windows-targeted privileged acceptance wrapper separately from the fast suite. It forwards the approved `TestLabRoot`, `TestId`, explicit VHDX/device/media/SMB/service/session inputs, real workload oracle, Agent history directory, explicit new `EvidenceRoot`, and fail-closed journal options to `Test-Privileged.ps1`. `-CreateVhdx` additionally requires `-ConfirmCreateVhdx`, an explicit GUID TestId included in the new VHDX filename, and the audited physical safety gates. The evidence path must be a new local fixed NTFS directory outside the repository, OneDrive, and Documents. Failure evidence and any created VHDX are retained; the runner does not automatically delete test data. Privileged hardware acceptance remains an explicit host concern; missing capabilities or product evidence produce `NOT_EXECUTED` and `AcceptanceEligible=false` rather than a synthetic pass.
